disclosureQuote: AI powers real-time dialogue and responses from fictional in-game characters, allowing them to react dynamically to player conversations and actions.
summary: 多人合作诈骗呼叫中心模拟，2026 年 10 月 15 日由 Jatater Worldwide 发行并进入抢先体验。商店披露只有一句：AI 驱动游戏内虚构角色的实时对话与回应，使其能对玩家的谈话与操作即时反应；其余七个领域都是披露未说明。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 JakeHub 与 Metater，发行商 Jatater Worldwide）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 1299），首页有 1 个与 AI 直接相关的主题（“The AI service is temporarily unavailable, please try again shortly”），已逐帖读取原文：多名玩家报告通话时反复只拿到“AI 服务暂时不可用”的提示、重装与清本地文件都无效，属玩家故障报告，没有开发方在帖中说明服务范围；按规则只登记不判定，不改变任何领域结论（它也不能替代披露去证明语音是否由真人或合成产生）。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：一条 Reddit 帖经 GitHub Actions 中转抓取实测返回 HTTP 403，正文不可读，其余结果为本作商店页、本作好评排序评测列表页、Instagram 与 Facebook 的宣传短视频与一段 YouTube 实况，均无可读的第三方核实内容；检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。披露没有说明这些对话是以文字还是语音呈现，因此配音领域按“披露未说明”登记，不并入游戏内实时生成那句的范围。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。本作处于抢先体验阶段。
description: 和朋友一起经营诈骗呼叫中心：用越来越离谱的话术骗过 AI 来电者，黑进他们的电脑拿资料，完成每日指标否则被老板开除。

english.summary: A co-op scam call-centre simulation published by Jatater Worldwide and in Early Access since Oct 15, 2026. The disclosure is a single sentence stating that AI powers real-time dialogue and responses from fictional in-game characters so they react dynamically to player conversations and actions; the other seven areas are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developers JakeHub and Metater, publisher Jatater Worldwide) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 1299), where one topic directly concerns AI; it was opened and read in full. Several players report that calls only return an AI service temporarily unavailable message and that reinstalling and clearing local files does not help, with no developer post in the thread describing the service scope, so it is logged as player trouble reports and changes no area finding, and it cannot substitute for the disclosure on how dialogue is presented. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw sources were read: a Reddit thread returned HTTP 403 through the relay with no readable body, and the remaining results were the store page, this game's top-rated reviews list, promotional short videos on Instagram and Facebook and a YouTube playthrough, none of which carries readable third-party verification; that describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. The disclosure does not say whether the dialogue is delivered as text or as speech, so the voice area is recorded as not addressed rather than folded into the in-game sentence. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The title is in Early Access.
